Professional Experience / Work History  
During my tenure as a Frontend Engineer at VerveLabs, I focused on architecting scalable component-driven design systems that streamlined cross-team collaboration. This involved refining reusable UI patterns and establishing guidelines that reduced redundancy by 30% across projects. I also mentored junior engineers, fostering a culture of code reviews and knowledge sharing. Prior to this, at Aurora Innovations, I led the responsive design overhaul for their SaaS platform, ensuring seamless user experiences across devices. This included implementing a mobile-first strategy that improved load times by 25% and enhanced user engagement metrics. Additionally, I integrated REST APIs to synchronize data between frontend and backend systems, reducing manual intervention in workflows. My earlier role at NovaTech Solutions as a Junior Developer provided foundational experience in version control and UI component development, which later translated into more complex responsibilities at Aurora.  

Technical Skills / Technologies  
JavaScript has been central to my work, particularly in building dynamic interfaces that handle real-time data updates. At VerveLabs, I leveraged its capabilities to create interactive dashboards that improved data visualization for stakeholders. React has been instrumental in driving large-scale applications, where I took ownership of state management solutions using Redux and Zustand, ensuring predictable data flow and reducing bugs by 40%. TypeScript has enhanced my ability to write maintainable code, especially in legacy systems where I refactored monolithic components into modular, type-safe structures. Next.js has enabled server-side rendering for performance-critical projects, such as the SaaS platform at Aurora, where it improved SEO rankings and reduced bounce rates. For web performance optimization, I implemented lazy loading and code splitting techniques that cut initial load times by 35%. Web accessibility standards (WCAG) were a priority, with I18n implementations ensuring compliance for global users. REST API design was a key focus at Aurora, where I standardized endpoints to improve integration efficiency.
